results.title: “Turning novels into music:” A Storied Conversation With YOASOBI - Atwood Magazine
results.content: This isn’t your dad’s 70s era prog rock concept album though – for YOASOBI, it’s quite literal. Comprised of producer Ayase and vocalist Ikura (stage name of Lilas Ikuta), YOASOBI’s debut track, “Yoru ni Kakeru” (“Racing Into the Night”) is a musical interpolation of An Invitation From Thanatos, a short story on Sony Music Japan’s creative writing social media service Monogatary. results.title: J-Pop Duo YOASOBI Talk Creative Process, Solo Work, and Vocaloid Influences | Teen Vogue
results.content: Take their debut single, "夜に駆ける (Yoru ni Kakeru)." Adapted from Mayo Hoshino's melancholic short tale タナトスの誘惑 (Thanatos no Yūwaku), which translates to The Temptation of Thanatos, the song depicts a love between the narrator and a young woman who repeatedly attempts to take her own life. Ultimately, they both succumb to the allure of death, falling into the unknown together. It's bleak.
